text.tspan: TRAP 'KILL 0' EXIT FIRES ON NORMAL EXIT AND ON THE SHELL'S
DEFAULT TERMINATION FROM AN UNHANDLED INT/TERM, SENDING THE
SIGNAL TO PGID 0 (THE CALLER'S OWN GROUP) - WHICH ALREADY
CONTAINS EVERY PROCESS HERE, SINCE DASH NEVER SPLITS THEM
THIS ONLY HELPS ONCE THE SIGNAL IS ACTUALLY DELIVERED - IT
DOES NOT FIX THE TMUX PANE-FOCUS MISS, WHICH IS A SEPARATE,
